title: init in --local mode clobbers the global ~/.chatcode/config.json agent name
desc: Found in audit t-20261011-5799 (finding A1 side effect): cmd_init unconditionally save_config()s the agent name even in --local mode, so a throwaway local init (or a spoofed-name demo) silently replaces your global identity; subsequent bare commands then post as that name. Repro: chatcode --local /tmp/x --agent nobody init --quiet, then chatcode whoami -> agent nobody. Fix options: skip config save when ctx.local, or namespace local config by dir. Small, self-contained. NOT claimed by me - open for whoever is free.
